verdicts.reason: Quote is verbatim (community-networking-cx.md:127-128), but it is a rationale clause whose operative point is the second half ('a scene must never be defined as a feed weighting'). The same file states the normative position twice — line 14 ('candidacy, never rank ... ranking reads evidence, never membership') and line 138 ('fan-out set only — candidacy, never rank') — and the owning ranking file enumerates ranking inputs and excludes membership outright (03.02.02-ranking-relevance-controls.md:84), as does 03.06.01-scene-definition-membership.md:124 (D-08). The sub-domain index restates it a fifth time as a resolved question: 03.06-scenes-communities-index.md:75 Q-03 — 'the weighting half is refused ... never rank (how anything scores)'. Five normative statements against one loose narrative clause; an implementer of the feed scorer reads 03.02.02, which is unambiguous. A copy-edit defect, not an operative divergence.

All quoted lines verified (community-networking-index.md:77/82/84/96-97; 03.01-...-index.md:41; 03.01.01-follows.md:31; 03.06.01:33; 03.08-...-index.md:44). But the domain matrix carries an explicit precedence rule directly above the cited note — community-networking-index.md:94: 'Access icons are shorthand; detailed per-role behavior lives in each feature file's Role Lens.' Each domain-level cell aggregates 3-4 children with divergent access (03.01 = Full/None/Read-only; 03.06 = Full/Read-only/Config/Config; 03.08 = Full/None/Config/Config), so a single icon is necessarily lossy and the tree names the authoritative source. The leaf is unambiguous in every cited case (03.01.01:31 'The only graph edge available to them'), and the reading note at :96-97 is a true description of its own table's Fan column (Full appears only on the 03.02 and 03.09 rows). No implementer building the Fan surface converges on 'Fan cannot press Follow'.

Quote verified at 03.01-connections-follows-endorsements-cx.md:58, but it is a breadth-phase note carrying its own '[PENDING — /ideate-discover Step 5 deepening]' marker and the hedged verb 'MAY' — it asserts nothing and licenses nothing. The prohibition is ratified in four places: 03.01.01-follows.md:145 (DT-11, REJECTED), :180 (D-12), and the parent domain CX at community-networking-cx.md:118 and :387 (R-07, 'Connection and follow stay separate consent acts'). No document in the tree asserts that auto-follow happens. An implementer wiring connection-accept consults the feature that owns the follow edge and finds a hard D-12. Stale synthesis note, not a live contradiction.

Verified verbatim. 03.01.02-professional-connections.md:71 carries a bare '`[PENDING]`' on the inbound-expiry horizon — no owner, no stage — while DT-05 at :98 makes expiry one of three cooperating parts the mechanism cannot work without ('a quota, a same-pair re-send cooldown, and inbound expiry — not one') and the Behavior section at :52-55 declares everything but the cap's shape settled. The file's own Q-01 is explicitly scoped to the cap's shape only, so it does not carry the horizon; grep across the whole 03.01 sub-domain finds no other mention of connection-request expiry. The file demonstrates the correct form two rows down at :77 ('`[PENDING — Step 5 Must-depth or /write-be-spec]`' on the exact cooldown), and the [DEEP] sibling fixes comparable numbers in-layer (03.01.01:177, D-09 '60/rolling hour and 500/rolling 24h'). Mitigating: the file is [PARTIAL] status and the divergence is a scalar, not a product-behaviour fork — hence warning, not blocking. The tracking marker is genuinely malformed and no downstream gate is pointed at it.

The claimed inversion does not exist. 03.03.01-collaborator-search-browse.md:38-42 is corroborated verbatim at the global cross-cut layer — ideation-cx.md:188 (row 128): 'The D-15 playable-radius bounds in-room search: you cannot "jam in the room" with someone outside the latency budget, so the search radius is a function of 08's transport constraint.' The sibling does not state the opposite: 03.03.03:37-38 only attaches D-15 to the remote/in-the-room distinction generally ('a physics question, not a preference'), naming neither branch as the bounded one. 03.03.01's mapping also matches its own DT-03 at :109 (hard constraint for real-time, irrelevant for asynchronous) and its edge case at :90 treats mode as the cause of an empty in-room result. The numeric radius is a tracked deferral, not an invention: ideation-cx.md:31 — 'the ~25-30ms playable-together ceiling (D-15; exact numeric budget set in /create-prd performance-budget)'.

R-02 is quoted correctly (03.03-collaborator-discovery-matchmaking-cx.md:108) but 03.03.01 never contradicts it. The file distinguishes 'axis' from 'filter' as deliberate vocabulary — 03.03.01:128, D-04: '"Remote / in the room" is a primary query axis, not a filter' — so listing Appetite among the axes at :49-50 is not a filter claim. The only filtering the Happy Path names is explicit and narrow: :73 'filtering out blocked and unreachable people before ranking' — open-to signals appear as a candidate-resolution input, not a filter predicate. No decision in 03.03.01's D-table makes appetite exclusionary, and 03.03.01:87 already routes stale-signal handling to 03.03.03 decay rather than exclusion. Both readings converge on 'scored, with decay-awareness'.

Both quotes verified (03.04.01:169/:210/:225; 03.04.04:89/:129). But nothing asserts the contrary of D-03: 03.04.04 records the question as open, it never states fail-open as policy. The answer exists and is stated three times in the file that owns the `unknown` value (03.04.01 D-03, the Behavior note at :169, the cross-cut note at :210 naming 03.04.04 by name). The tracking is well-formed, not silent — 03.04.04 Q-04 carries owner 'Agent' and target '/create-prd-architecture', and 03.04.01:210 explicitly names the interaction ('which sharpens its own Q-04'), so the architecture stage arrives with D-03 in hand. 03.04.04 is [PARTIAL] status. A stale open question superseded by a ratified upstream constraint is not two normative statements that cannot both hold.

The claim 'nor tracked by any open question' is false. The file that owns density measurement tracks the metric with owner and target: 03.06.02-scene-graph-density-map.md:99 — 'Q-02 | [OWNER] What is the density metric — edges, components, path length, clustering? ... | Agent | `/create-prd`' — and the threshold is not expressible until the metric is chosen. The pre-density behaviour an implementer must ship is fully specified, not invented: 03.04.04:59-61 'until the graph is dense, the default must behave as Open regardless of the chosen level.' The gate itself is a MoSCoW sequencing statement (03.04.04:74, :98), and moscow-ledger.md:246 places 03.04.04 at Should with that gate recorded, so nothing forces an implementer to pick a threshold to ship. 03.04.04 is [PARTIAL] status.

Verified: 03.04.02-warm-intro-requests-brokering.md:64 does say 'Decay (Q-03 on 03.04.01)' and 03.04.01's current Q-03 (:250) is about graph-integrity monitoring. But the target file answers the question unmissably and in four places: 03.04.01:80-82 (Behavior), :143 and :144 (edge cases naming the identical 2009 scenario), :198 (DT-14, 'REJECTED as weighting / CONFIRMED as disclosure', which cites 03.04.02's edge case as its own premise) and :233 (D-11, whose context column reads 'DT-14 — resolves parent Q-03/this file's Q-03'). 03.04.02 carries no decision prescribing decay — a single word in one edge-case cell against four explicit statements. The pointer's number is stale; the destination is correct and self-identifying.

One of the three cited 'removals' does not say what is claimed: 03.04.01:162 (GDPR erasure) reads 'Node and edges non-traversable at once' — non-traversable, not deleted — which is exactly the treatment the finding says a cautious implementer would wrongly build. Of the remaining two, 03.01.01:97 concerns follow edges, a different edge type that D-10 keeps out of this graph entirely. That leaves :147 (dispute lost, 'Edge removed permanently') against D-11, whose scope is fixed by its own rationale at :233 and :80-82 — decay and age ('Time alone cannot distinguish ... deleting evidenced history is the reconstruction failure run in reverse'). A dispute resolved against the claimant means 'the fact was never true' (:147), so no evidenced history is being deleted; under D-01 (derived, never authored) the edge ceases to derive. The specific edge-case rows are unambiguous and govern over the general clause.

The CX-04 entry does not assert what is claimed. But the entire CX-03 entry is itself marked '`[PENDING — /ideate-discover Step 5 deepening]`' at :73 and closes 'Synthesis questions answered: deferred — Medium confidence entry' at :78 — the wrong pointer sits inside content the tree flags as unwritten. 03.06.03 is [SURFACE] and 03.06.02 is [SURFACE] (index :33-34). The bare '`[PENDING]`' at 03.08.02-submissions-eligibility.md:57 is real, but the same file's States table answers the question normatively: :70 — '| Frozen | Judging began | Entry locked |'. An entry locked at the start of judging cannot be withdrawn during judging, which is the behaviour the finding says must be invented, and it is consistent with D-01's freeze-at-submission and with 03.08.04:105 (D-05, losing entries revert entirely) covering the post-verdict path. The unanswered residue is the consequence framing, not the rule. Context also weakens the severity: all four 03.08 children are '**Status**: [SURFACE]' (:5 in each) and moscow-ledger.md:524-527 places the whole sub-domain in COULD (201), so exhaustive edge-case depth is not yet claimed for this unit.
